jcr:title: JCR Repository Basics
author: cms-admin
body:
The Java Content Repository (JCR) API is the foundation for content storage in Apache Sling. JCR provides a standardized way to access content repositories, with Apache Jackrabbit being the most common implementation.

JCR treats content as a hierarchical tree of nodes, where each node can have properties and child nodes. This tree structure maps naturally to web URLs, making JCR ideal for content management systems.

Key concepts include nodes (content items), properties (name-value pairs), and workspaces (separate content trees). JCR also supports versioning, observation (event listening), and querying capabilities.
summary: Exploring the Java Content Repository, the data storage layer of Apache Sling.
tags: JCR, Java Content Repository, Jackrabbit, Content Storage, Node Hierarchy
title: JCR Repository Basics
